song:polynomial-c.title: Polynomial-C
song:polynomial-c.label: Warp
song:polynomial-c.notes: Cold-open arpeggio. Plucky 4-op FM signature, debate over SH-101 vs DX100 origin — frame as FM-style sound design regardless of source synth.

song:xtal.title: Xtal
song:xtal.label: R&S
song:xtal.notes: Bell motif uses DX7 ROM 11 E.PIANO 1. Pad bed is sampled from 1986 library record 'Evil at Play' — not synthesised. Reverb Machine 2022 teardown.

song:bike.title: Bike
song:bike.label: Warp
song:bike.notes: Tuned-percussion FM signatures in opening 30 seconds. Often misattributed to Tri Repetae — flag this. Booth confirms 'loads of FM-Synths' on Incunabula in WATMM AMA.

song:an-ending-ascent.title: An Ending (Ascent)
song:an-ending-ascent.label: EG
song:an-ending-ascent.notes: DX7 'Glide' patch + Mesa Boogie + Lexicon PCM-70. Foundation pad is CS-80 per Lanois. The anti-pluck demo.

song:beep-street.title: Beep Street
song:beep-street.label: Warp
song:beep-street.notes: TX81Z lead with breath-controller character. Sampled drum break is James Brown's 'Soul Pride' (per WhoSampled). Already in stemforge library.

song:take-on-me.title: Take On Me
song:take-on-me.label: Warner Bros
song:take-on-me.notes: DX7 ROM 1A 15 'BASS 1' — single carrier with one modulator at 1:1, sharp modulator envelope. Eighty percent of '80s pop bass came from this exact patch.

song:greatest-love-of-all.title: Greatest Love of All
song:greatest-love-of-all.label: Arista
song:greatest-love-of-all.notes: Solo E.PIANO 1 introduction (0:00–0:25 unaccompanied). Carrier sine for the tine, modulator at high ratio for bell-attack chirp. Velocity-sensitive.

song:french-kiss.title: French Kiss
song:french-kiss.album: From the Mind of Lil Louis
song:french-kiss.label: Epic
song:french-kiss.notes: TX81Z 'Lately Bass' — named for Janet Jackson's 'What Have You Done For Me Lately' (1986), not Reese.

song:stria.title: Stria
song:stria.label: CCRMA
song:stria.notes: Frequency components, temporal divisions, and formal proportions all based on powers of φ ≈ 1.618. Crystalline inharmonic spectra. Hard to source — try CCRMA archives or IRCAM catalogue. If unavailable: replace with hand-built Operator patch at 1:φ ratio.

song:black-refraction.title: Black Refraction
song:black-refraction.label: Kranky
song:black-refraction.notes: Modern FM ambient practice: stacked Operator instances at irrational ratios, very long envelopes, modulator level automated by slow LFOs. The 2010s descendant of Apollo, darker.
